note: Example handoff packet for Claude Design. All people, events, pings, and predictions are fictional. Chart compute is real (Swiss Ephemeris against fictional birth data) so the data shape matches production exactly.

people.name: Avery
people.notes: Sample primary user for the design handoff. Fictional.

events.description: Started a new project at work — managing the migration to a new vendor.
Long phone call with Mom — she shared a story from her childhood I had never heard.
Sam and I made breakfast together for the first time in weeks. Felt grounded.

pings.note: Tired. The work intensity is starting to weigh.
1966 keeps surfacing — Baumol, Dusty Springfield, Jeff Beck retrospective.
Slept well. Quiet morning. Feels like something is shifting.

predictions.prediction_text: Expect work pressure to peak; possible self-doubt about identity in role.
predictions.verdict_text: Work pressure peaked Wednesday; had a hard conversation with my manager about role direction.

predictions.prediction_text: Possible warmth in close relationships; nostalgic family feelings.
